name: Local Computer
description: Persistent isolated desktop on this machine using Cua Sandbox.

provider.label: Local
provider.description: Isolated Linux VM stored and run on this machine through Cua Sandbox.

onboarding.subtitle: Prepare an isolated desktop on this device for all of your bots.

steps.title: Install or upgrade Cua
steps.desc: Runs in Recursive's terminal only after you click Install. Cua Sandbox 0.4.3 or newer is required for the local VM path.

steps.title: Install virtualization
steps.desc: Install a virtualization backend for your operating system.
steps.markdown:
**macOS**
```bash
python3 -m pip install --upgrade 'cua-sandbox>=0.4.3' cua
brew install qemu
```

**Windows**
```powershell
py -m pip install --upgrade 'cua-sandbox>=0.4.3' cua
winget install SoftwareFreedomConservancy.QEMU
```

**Linux**
```bash
python3 -m pip install --upgrade 'cua-sandbox>=0.4.3' cua
# Install qemu-system with your distribution package manager
```

Recursive never runs these system installers silently. You approve them on your device, then Recursive verifies the selected runtime.

steps.title: Choose the Python environment
steps.desc: Use the Python 3.12+ command where the cua package is installed.

steps.title: Test Cua and virtualization
steps.desc: Checks that Cua can load and the configured VM or container backend is available. On Apple Silicon, the current Cua Linux disk runs through x86_64 software emulation and may start slowly.

schema.label: Full virtual machine
